'''Rayche Emperva''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] living in the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. After a leader of a prominent [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang arrived on Rishi, other pirates who already had a presence on Rishi challenged his authority and Rayche quietly informed the newcomer about a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] put on the newcomer's head.
